description: Edge cases used in definitions/<family-slug>.json. Each id is defined once here; a concept's edge_cases list uses these ids only. Add a case here (id, label, description) only when no existing case fits, and keep descriptions about the input, never about a tool.

edgeless.label: Edgeless graph
edgeless.description: The graph has nodes but no edges (m = 0).

single_node.label: Single node
single_node.description: The graph has exactly one node (n = 1), with or without a self-loop.

two_nodes.label: Two nodes
two_nodes.description: The graph has exactly two nodes.

small_n.label: Too few nodes for the formula
small_n.description: The graph has fewer nodes than a normalizing constant or a term of the formula needs (for example n < 3 when dividing by (n-1)(n-2)), so a division by zero or an empty sum arises.

isolates.label: Isolated nodes
isolates.description: At least one node has no edge to any other node (degree 0), in a graph that has other edges.

self_loops.label: Self-loops
self_loops.description: An edge whose source and target are the same node.

multi_edges.label: Parallel edges
multi_edges.description: Several edges with the same source and target (same endpoints, for undirected edges).

disconnected.label: Disconnected graph
disconnected.description: An undirected graph with more than one connected component, or a directed graph that is not weakly connected: some pairs of nodes have no path.

directed_unreachable.label: Directed graph, unreachable pairs
directed_unreachable.description: A directed graph in which some node cannot reach another along edge directions although the graph may be weakly connected (not strongly connected).

direction.label: Undirected versus directed input
direction.description: The same measure applied to an undirected graph (each edge usable both ways) and to a directed graph (edges usable from source to target only), including which degree or distance direction is scored.

weights.label: Edge weights
weights.description: How edge weights enter: as lengths (costs) in path measures, as strengths (capacities, tie intensities) in degree, flow and spectral measures, or ignored.

ties.label: Ties and equal values
ties.description: Several shortest paths of equal length, equal scores, or equal eigenvalues, including ties that arise only in floating point (for example equal sums of reciprocals).

complete_graph.label: Complete graph
complete_graph.description: Every pair of distinct nodes is joined by an edge. All nodes are structurally equivalent.

star.label: Star
star.description: One centre joined to every other node and no other edges.

bipartite.label: Bipartite or two-mode graph
bipartite.description: The node set splits into two classes with edges only between classes (periodic structure; two-mode data).

parameter_domain.label: Parameter outside its valid range
parameter_domain.description: A free parameter (attenuation, damping, decay, exponent, walk length) outside the range for which the series or fixed point is defined or convergent.

group_input.label: Degenerate group or subset input
group_input.description: A group, source set, target set or sample that is empty, a single node, or the whole node set.
